svg.title: BARIA — AI Restaurant Booker · System architecture
svg.desc: BARIA Electron desktop uses React and TypeScript. Electron Main connects through authenticated REST and WebSocket to FastAPI. LangGraph coordinates scoped tools; BookingExecutionService owns booking state. Observability records events in application SQLite, with a separate SQLite checkpoint file. A separate FastAPI voice gateway shares a SQLite mailbox with the booking backend and integrates OpenAI Live and Twilio. Manual Overpass imports supply cached OpenStreetMap restaurant data. Application DB and Event Store are logical groups within one physical file.
